Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were
involved in at the intersection in League City. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Please state your full name and the address where you currently live.
A: I'd rather just give my first name for now, and I live in League City.
Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection?
A: I was driving through on a green light, heading straight across. Another vehicle came from my right side and puleld
out into the intersection. I hit the brakes but couldn't avoid it. Their front end struck the driver's side of my car.
Q: Was your vehicle moving at the time of impact?
A: Yes, I was coming through at maybe the posted speed. I'd say I wasn't going fast.
Q: Did you see the other driver's signal or any indication they were going to stop?
A: No. They just came out. I don't think they were stopped long enough to look.
Q: Did you have any injuries after the collision?
A: Yes, my right shoulder took the force of the seatbelt and hit the door frame. It's sore and I've had trouble lifting my
arm above my head since.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with a specialist.
Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?
A: A couple of days so far. I'm still working around the restrictions.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your account of the accident?
A: Just that I'm willing to provide the photos I took at the scene and the clinic paperwork if you need them.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
</page>
